topic: Database schema and inventory linking issues
tags: summary_markdown: | The conversation covered two main technical issues. First, a user attempted to create a ClickHouse dictionary (`user_access_dict`) using an ODBC source connection string that failed due to unsupported array types in the current setup. It was determined that the schema should be updated to use a native POSTGRESQL source instead of ODBC for proper functionality.| For the second issue, regarding inventory import/export and box placement (boxmacks), the existing 1-to-many relationship between facilities and boxes needs refinement. The team discussed several options: limiting the relationship, updating only the first box, or implementing a dedicated linking import. A proposed solution was to require two records for moving a box: one nullifying its old facility link and a second establishing the new link.| It was noted that operational teams frequently link warehouse inventory to a single facility, but generally, the relationship is 1-to-1 outside of warehouses. The suggestion was made to add a `facility.is_warehouse` flag to manage this exception.

decisions: The ClickHouse dictionary source should be changed from ODBC to POSTGRESQL for array support.
action_items: Implement logic requiring two records (old link nullification and new link establishment) when moving a box to maintain data integrity.
Consider adding a `facility.is_warehouse` flag to handle exceptions where warehouse inventory links to a single facility, while maintaining 1:1 for other cases.
